code_identity_contract.submission_value: EXPECTED_COMMIT is the full 40-character candidate SHA supplied to qsub
code_identity_contract.required_equality: EXPECTED_COMMIT == clean worktree HEAD == manifest identities.code.commit

writer_invariant.formal_role_enforcement: only proposal_writer may publish; proposal_discoverer is read-only

state_identities.run_identity: s1-05-${PBS_JOBID}; byte-identical to manifest run_identity.identity and every role/summary record

bounded_base_retention.validated_facts: S_max=0 retains exactly one base per each of four fragments and binds the same config model and fragment-map identities

authoritative_observation.discovery_interval: one complete ProposalStore.discover_latest call over the frozen eight-learner four-fragment slot set
authoritative_observation.discovery_io_counter: CountingStorageBackend read invocations at the proposal API boundary
authoritative_observation.partial_publication: remote load_latest before a complete visibility record must raise and return no proposal
authoritative_observation.latest_monotonic: under the frozen single-writer and one-in-flight invariant a delayed sequence-2 task that reaches publish after sequence 3 is visible must reject and final latest must remain sequence 3
authoritative_observation.idempotence: identical same-sequence publication creates zero new immutable payloads and preserves the content identity
authoritative_observation.same_sequence_conflict: different content under the same learner fragment and sequence rejects before changing latest authority
authoritative_observation.one_per_learner: selected proposal count equals distinct selected learner count for every shared decision vector and permutation
authoritative_observation.fixed_frontier: one run/map/fragment-bound pair of last consumed sequence and base version per frozen learner independent of update history
authoritative_observation.decoded_schema: summary inventories every decoded proposal identity progress base payload checksum and content field and asserts complete-local-parameters payload binding
authoritative_observation.generic_eligibility: identity integrity frontier progress base retention and 0 <= current-base <= S_max use one deterministic rejection path with no S_max-zero branch
authoritative_observation.weighting: normalized float32 tokens/(1+lambda_s*staleness) matches the shared Stage 0 oracle

formal_package: S1-00 builder/finalizer/validator with clean code/config/source/skill/scheduler/role/path identity and fail-if-exists root
failure_ladder: preserve the first L2 package; reproduce on one compute node with the same commit and deterministic 32-slot workload before any resubmission
